title: Cancel on New Tier creates nothing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Note how many active tiers the Tiers list shows (for example 6).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Tier.
  3. Type a name no other tier uses.
  4. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list shows 6 active tiers.

Step 2:

  • The new tier's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name shows in the field.

Step 4:

  • The Tiers list shows again.
  • It still shows 6 active tiers (6 = 6) and the typed name is not listed.
